title: Jump to a component pin in the schematic
summary: Finds a pin of a placed component with schematic iterators, then zooms to it with the undocumented Sch:CrossProbeNotify process or selects it; documents what the cross-probe does and that it fails silently.
phrasings: zoom to a pin on a schematic sheet
cross-probe a component pin from code
select a pin by component designator
run a built-in process with RunCommand

commands.name: JumpToPin
commands.description: Jump to a component pin (cross-probe, or select it with Method=Select)
